decisions.reason: The landing-page section-spacing adjustment does not change the implementation stack, handoff objective, or handoff scope.
The source changes general section spacing but does not specify a breakpoint, viewport, orientation, or responsive-layout rule.
Changing one landing-page section gap does not necessarily alter the required spacing-scale token category or any documented token value in the candidate state.
The spacing adjustment is explicitly limited to landing-page sections and does not establish a corresponding rule for follow-on pages.
The landing-page spacing decision does not change the console shell's styling requirements; the separate dashboard discussion in the same message is already represented by its lifecycle event.
Adjusting spacing between landing-page sections does not change the requirement for no header navigation.
The source does not change the footer or its strategy for adding page links over time.
The landing-page section-spacing adjustment has no necessary effect on Actia branding for the sign-in page.
The source does not change the wizard-specific page margins, panel dimensions, progress-node sizing, or portrait and landscape spacing.
